I love Wispr Flow. It works across Android, iOS, Mac, and Windows (except Snapdragon). It's nearly perfect. 

There is one major caveat, though: you cannot easily switch to other keyboards if you use an iPhone Duo. It wouldn't be that big of a deal if Wispr Flow's keyboard was decent, but it's really, really, really bad. 

I'm sure this will be changed or updated very soon, but worth noting.
